summary: GreenPower Motor Co. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing the resignation of board member Sebastian Giordano, effective immediately. No stake, price, or premium terms were disclosed. The board thanked Giordano and noted his transition to an advisory role. The filing is a standard material change report under Canadian rules (51-102F3), mapped to a US 6-K. This is a routine board resignation with continued advisory support; no acquisition, tender, or restructuring event is present.
